content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To pick out favorite superhero movie, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Write down the title of the winner (2 minutes)
Step 2. Print out a list of all superhero movies ever released (15 minutes)
Step 3. Rewatch the final three contenders (6 hours)
Step 4. Make the final decision on the absolute favorite (30 minutes)
Step 5. Categorize movies by comic book publisher (1 hour)
Step 6. Filter out movies with less than a 60% Rotten Tomatoes score (45 minutes)
Step 7. Discuss the top 10 list with a fellow fan (1 hour)
Step 8. Compare the scores of the remaining semi-finalists (20 minutes)
Step 9. Create a spreadsheet to track rewatch progress (30 minutes)
Step 10. Watch all movies from the 1990s (10 hours)
Step 11. Watch all movies from the 2000s (20 hours)
Step 12. Search for obscure indie superhero films (2 hours)
Step 13. Narrow the list down to the top 3 (10 minutes)
Step 14. Rank the top 10 movies (15 minutes)
Step 15. Compile a list of all movies featuring caped heroes (40 minutes)
Step 16. Delete duplicates from the master list (5 minutes)
Step 17. Watch all movies from the 1980s (8 hours)
Step 18. Research movies released before 1980 (3 hours)
Step 19. Watch the original Superman and Batman films (5 hours)
Step 20. Sort the list by personal enjoyment rating (1 hour)
Step 21. Eliminate movies with poor special effects (30 minutes)
Step 22. Watch all movies from the 2010s to present (40 hours)
Step 23. Check user reviews on IMDb (2 hours)
Step 24. Mark movies that are part of a shared universe (20 minutes)
Step 25. Group movies by their lead actor (30 minutes)
Step 26. Evaluate the quality of the villains (1 hour)
Step 27. Identify movies that won Academy Awards (20 minutes)
Step 28. Identify movies available on streaming services (15 minutes)
Step 29. Log the director of each film (1 hour)
Step 30. Sort the list alphabetically (5 minutes)
Step 31. Watch the highest-grossing films on the list (12 hours)
Step 32. Verify the release dates for every film (2 hours)
Step 33. Tag movies that have a female lead (10 minutes)
Step 34. Check for post-credit scenes in each movie (3 hours)
Step 35. Gather a list of animated superhero features (2 hours)
Step 36. Read the original comic books for context (1 week)
Step 37. Reflect on the emotional impact of the top choice (1 day)
Step 38. Download high-resolution posters for the top 20 (30 minutes)
Step 39. Buy a new notebook for movie notes (20 minutes)
Step 40. Watch all sequels and spin-offs (30 hours)
Step 41. Rate the musical scores of each film (4 hours)
Step 42. Listen to movie critic podcasts (5 hours)
Step 43. Look up trivia for the most popular films (1 hour)
Step 44. Browse the superhero section at the local library (1 hour)
Step 45. Remove movies that are parodies (10 minutes)
Step 46. Cross-reference the list with a "Best Of" magazine article (30 minutes)
Step 47. Organize movies by their primary setting or city (45 minutes)
Step 48. Subscribe to a movie news newsletter (5 minutes)
Step 49. Watch the top 5 most promising candidates (12 hours)
Step 50. Post the final list on social media (5 minutes)

Question: Assume that you need to execute all the steps to complete the task and that infinite resources are available. What is the shortest possible time to pick out favorite superhero movie?

The problem contains exactly 50 numbered steps. Your action ids must be:
